findings.environment: Python 3.11.15 isolated public wheel; no database
findings.expected_correct_behavior: A list-valued origin URL round-trips as one exact value.
findings.actual_v071_behavior: https://example.com is split into ["https", "//example.com"].
findings.security_impact: Security-sensitive allowlist configuration can be corrupted; no bypass was demonstrated.
findings.data_integrity_impact: None directly.
findings.compatibility_implications: A deterministic grammar may reject formerly ambiguous path-separator inputs.

findings.environment: Python 3.11.15 isolated public wheel; no database
findings.expected_correct_behavior: Generated Ticket SDK compiles under TypeScript 5.9.3 strict mode.
findings.actual_v071_behavior: Generation succeeds but tsc exits 2 with TS2322 because TicketListParams lacks the query helper index signature.
findings.data_integrity_impact: Generated clients are unusable under strict compilation.
findings.compatibility_implications: Generated list parameter typing becomes assignable without disabling strict mode.

findings.environment: Python 3.11.15 isolated public wheel; no database

findings.data_integrity_impact: A mutating action could perform unauthorized writes.
findings.compatibility_implications: Previously unauthorized custom calls become denials.

findings.environment: Python 3.11.15 isolated public wheel; PostgreSQL 18.4 database aksara_test
findings.expected_correct_behavior: A worker that loses ownership cannot overwrite the replacement owner result.
findings.actual_v071_behavior: A second worker reclaims active work; the stale first worker later overwrites the newer completed result.
findings.data_integrity_impact: Authoritative task state can be overwritten and handler effects can repeat.
findings.compatibility_implications: Internal task schema/claim behavior may tighten; ordinary Task remains distinct from Operation.

findings.expected_correct_behavior: cleanup=True pins supported writes to an owned rollback transaction and closes owned resources.
